preheader: Nvidia rally unravels, Fed inflation reaches 3.8%, and Anthropic slide creates paper millionaires.

lead.headline: The Nvidia Reinstatement Rally Trashes as Tech Stocks Plunge Again
lead.body: U.S. stocks dropped sharply on Wednesday as gains from Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO completely erased. The Nasdaq tumbled 4.1% while chip makers, neoclouds, and recent IPOs led a steep market sell-off.
lead.why: As a business student following tech valuations, this sudden reversal highlights how quickly market sentiment turns when AI enthusiasm collides with profit concerns.

stories.headline: Anthropic Post-IPO Slide Tests AI Valuations
stories.body: Anthropic shares fell below their initial public offering price as Wall Street questions whether AI companies can deliver expected profits. Even with the drop, the debut turned roughly 5,100 employees into paper millionaires.
stories.why: Understanding equity compensation and post-IPO lockup risks will help you evaluate startup job offers down the road.

stories.headline: Fed's Preferred Inflation Metric Hits 3.8%
stories.body: The personal consumption expenditures price index rose to 3.8% in October, nearly double the Federal Reserve's target. The jump increases expectations that the central bank might raise interest rates next month.
stories.why: Higher interest rates increase borrowing costs for startups and depress valuation multiples across public equity markets.

stories.headline: AI Researchers Warn Advanced Models May Be Unsafe to Launch
stories.body: Insiders at Anthropic and OpenAI report that their most advanced unreleased models are becoming harder to control. Researchers worry these systems may never reach safety levels required for public distribution.
stories.why: AI governance and risk management will be critical topics when you advise enterprise clients or launch tech products.

stories.headline: Nvidia Settles $290M Crypto Suit Amid Governance Concerns
stories.body: Nvidia agreed to pay $290 million to settle a 2018 shareholder lawsuit regarding crypto revenue disclosures. At the same time, analysts pointed out governance risks in relying heavily on a founder CEO without a clear succession plan.
stories.why: Analyzing how corporate governance impacts market valuation is a key theme in management courses at Merage.

stories.headline: McKinsey Highlights 3.7 Million European Jobs at Risk
stories.body: A new report from McKinsey & Company estimates that 3.7 million European industrial jobs face direct financial risk. Almost half of the region's industrial firms experienced financial stress in 2025.
stories.why: Operational turnarounds and restructuring in distressed international markets will fuel demand for management consulting services.

stories.headline: Campus Tech Placements Drop as Leaders Stress AI Skills
stories.body: University campus placements in IT dropped by up to 20% as basic coding tasks get automated. LinkedIn CEO Daniel Shapero noted that graduates who learn to apply AI to solve complex problems still hold an edge.
stories.why: For your upcoming summer internship hunt, showing practical problem-solving using AI tools will matter more than standard technical skills.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Team Combines AI and Physics for Fluid Modeling
stories.body: Researchers at UC Irvine created a computational method that pairs fundamental physics with AI to reconstruct precise fluid and blood flow models from sparse imaging data.

stories.headline: Jannik Sinner Undergoes Surgery, Leaving Australian Open in Doubt
stories.body: Former world No. 1 Jannik Sinner underwent right knee surgery, threatening his status for the Australian Open. Carlos Alcaraz supported his rival's decision to get treated, even as tour figures show viewership dropped significantly during Sinner's absence.

term.name: Paper Millionaire
term.definition: A paper millionaire is an employee or early investor whose equity holdings are valued at millions of dollars based on a company's stock price or valuation. Because the shares are often locked up or unliquidated, the wealth exists only on paper and can disappear if the market falls before they can sell.

serve.headline: Project Omega raised $12M to build batteries from nuclear waste
serve.body: Rhode Island startup Project Omega raised $12 million to transform radioactive nuclear waste into AA-size batteries. The funding will support prototypes built to power military and government devices for years.
